title: Stable Generalization under Small Shifts to Imaging Conditions for Neural Network Analysis of High-Resolution Transmission Electron Microscopy
content: Successful deployment of machine learning techniques in electron microscopy requires careful consideration of model generalization. While there exists both empirical evidence and approximate theoretical frameworks to support the excellent in-domain generalization behavior of neural network models [1], where data encountered in the experimental environment for testing scenarios are similar to a model's training data, comparatively little is known about the their out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization behavior, where testing data differs in its data-generating process. Importantly, model performance can be quite brittle with respect to the input data, like in the worst-case adversarial scenarios, in which small, imperceptible perturbations to the input data cause catastrophic inference failure.
